title: Derivative of the radial field γ(|y−ξ|)(y−ξ), including the centre (Simon Ch. 4, 3.2)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Ambient n ℓ, Euclidean inner product ⟨·,·⟩ and norm |·|), γ : ℝ → ℝ of class C¹, and ξ, x ∈ E; put r = |x − ξ|. Then the vector field g(y) = γ(|y − ξ|)(y − ξ) is Fréchet differentiable at x with derivative Dg(x)v = γ(r)v + (γ'(r)/r)⟨x − ξ, v⟩(x − ξ) for v ∈ E, where γ'(r)/r is read as 0 when r = 0 (Lean's a/0 = 0); in particular Dg(ξ) = γ(0)·I.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : Ambient n ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → HasFDerivAt (fun y : Ambient n ℓ ↦ γ ‖y - ξ‖ • (y - ξ)) (γ ‖x - ξ‖ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Ambient n ℓ) + (deriv γ ‖x - ξ‖ / ‖x - ξ‖) • (innerSL ℝ (x - ξ)).smulRight (x - ξ)) x
